note: Knowledge Evolution layer: links each engineering rule to the Evidence Sets that support or contradict it, so rules become living entities. Empty now (no evidence sets yet) → every rule is 'asserted' (expert-only). As experiments/observations produce Evidence Sets, append links here (or via scripts/rule_support.mjs link) and the rule's confidence/status updates. An EVS that supports/contradicts a rule is the bridge from the Knowledge Graph back to the Engineering Playbook.
